people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Hushim
people.line: Son of Dan, ancestor of the Shuhamites.

translations.web: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
translations.bsb: These were the descendants of Dan by their clans: The Shuhamite clan from Shuham. These were the clans of Dan.
translations.kjv: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
